question: Who won the bypoll election and became Member of Legislative Assembly from Brajarajnagar constituency in Odisha, India in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alaka Mohanty.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alaka Mohanty:-**

 
 
• She is an Indian politician from the state of Odisha.
 
• **She is a member of the Biju Janata Dal (BJD) and is currently the Member of the Odisha Legislative Assembly (MLA) from the Brajarajnagar Assembly constituency wining the by-poll election in 2022.**
 
• Mohanty is a social worker and has been involved in various social activities in Brajarajnagar.
 
• **She is also a member of the BJD State Women's Wing.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Sudip Roy Barman:-**

 
 
• **He is an Indian politician from the state of Tripura. **
 
• He is a member of the Indian National Congress (INC) and is currently the Member of the Tripura Legislative Assembly (MLA) from Agartala constituency.
 
 
 
• **Piyush Goyal:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian politician and chartered accountant serving as a cabinet minister in the Government of India. **
 
• He is currently the Minister of Textiles, Minister of Commerce and Industry and Minister of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution.
 
• He is also the Leader of the House in Rajya Sabha.
